newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish KFK sees lower 96 profits.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish KFK sees lower 96 profits.

text.p: Leading Danish grain and feedstuffs wholesaler A/S Korn-og Foderstof Kompagniet (KFK) downwardly adjusted on Friday its pre-tax 1996 result forecast to 125 million crowns.

The company said last July when it announced a first-half 1996 pre-tax profit of 90 million crowns, down from the previous year's interim 156 million crowns, that it expected a considerably lower full year 1996 result.

Later it said a halving of 1996's full year 320 million crown pre-tax result could not be ruled out. It attributed the expected lower result to economic problems at a major client. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
